title: Hugging Face references for Muse Glimmer 30B were recorded
summary: On 2026-08-11, the Muse thread associated Muse Glimmer with three Hugging Face URLs: a model repository named Muse-Glimmer-30B, a page for quantized models based on it, and a Space bearing its name. Together, the dated links document a model page and related quantization and Space references visible by that date. They do not establish the model's release date, capabilities, ownership, or whether the message announced a new change.
